title: Idaltuh yan rufto le xaagi
intro: Atu qaago elle ugutta uddur tableh tan. Xaleyna karmak taturteh tan qasaalaytu, ginô madqooqi sadah yan xagana hirigte. Ken fanat soolah yan muuci, usuk kaxxam yanim yallih racmattah asta kinni—nabiyyih madqah yan rooci, horah addat yan legacy quukah yan. Tah assakat le num miyyaay?
clues: Anu idaltuuy, xaylo sinni xaleenak ooboke.
Yi ubka yi buxah marah qibnaytu akkuk temeete malaykoota tiysixxige.
Anu wale kee nabiyyi yomcowweeh, lakmisa marih fanat galab kak xageh an.
Yabba Yallih kataysa deqsitak sugeeh, anu acwa kaak suge kay ellecabo liggidittet.
Anu toobokoyta luk suge kaadu nabiyyi, nanu nammayak inkih ninni Rabbih barkat luk sugne.
Yi baxi kaaduk nabiyyih sugeeh, yi samad kitab kee nabiyyi yomcowwe.

outcome.label: Xalu
options: Usug alaaqah innal yaabamih dudda yomcowweh suge

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
